name: codex-reminder
description: Unofficial reminder for Codex replies and input requests in the VS Code status bar and Windows taskbar.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Codex Reminder requires local Codex session and Extension Host log files.

codexReminder.enabled.description: Enable Codex unread detection and the Windows taskbar badge.

codexReminder.showStatusBar.description: Show the unread count in the VS Code status bar as a fallback and shortcut.

codexReminder.clearActiveThreadOnFocus.description: Clear unread items for the currently visible Codex thread when this VS Code window gains focus.

codexReminder.pollIntervalMs.description: How often to inspect local Codex event files.

codexReminder.maxTaskbarCount.description: Largest numeric value rendered in the taskbar overlay; larger values use a plus sign.

codexReminder.codexHome.description: Optional Codex home directory. Leave empty to use CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex.

scripts.check:syntax: node --check src/config.js && node --check src/display-state.js && node --check src/extension.js && node --check src/event-classifier.js && node --check src/session-monitor.js && node --check src/taskbar-badge.js && node --check scripts/check-release.js && node --check scripts/verify-manifest.js && node --check scripts/verify-vsix.js
scripts.verify:package: npm run verify:manifest && npm run package:list && npm run package:vsix && npm run verify:vsix
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run check && npm run verify:manifest
